CVE-2026-33814 (GO-2026-4918): an HTTP/2 client that receives a SETTINGS frame with SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE set to 0 loops forever writing CONTINUATION frames. The bug is in golang.org/x/net/http2, fixed in 0.53.0, and in the HTTP/2 code built into Go's net/http, fixed in Go 1.25.10 and 1.26.3: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4918, https://go.dev/issue/78476, https://go.dev/cl/761581, https://go.dev/cl/761640, https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/qcCIEXso47M. Read the Go build information and the function table of every Go program in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 89 builds, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, every download checked against the index checksum. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/build. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index, every entry with the same source commit and installed size as 2.19.1-r0; the copy the repository serves was read. golang.org/x/net/http2 is linked into /usr/bin/build, but none of its HTTP/2 client code: in every build, no function table contains golang.org/x/net/http2.(*Transport) or (*clientConnReadLoop), so the golang.org/x/net half of this CVE is not present. Go's own HTTP/2 client in net/http is present, including the function the fix changes, net/http.(*http2clientConnReadLoop).processSettingsNoWrite. Builds before 2.15.0-r1 are built with Go 1.25.7, 1.25.8, 1.26.1 or 1.26.2, which are affected. From 2.15.0-r1 on, every Go program in the package is built with Go 1.26.3 or later; builds 2.15.0-r1 to 2.16.5-r0 still list golang.org/x/net 0.51.0, but without the client code that version's bug is in. The current 2.29.1-r1 uses Go 1.26.11 and golang.org/x/net 0.62.0.

CVE-2026-33814 (GO-2026-4918): the HTTP/2 client transport entered an infinite loop writing CONTINUATION frames when a server sent a SETTINGS frame with SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE set to 0. Go 1.26.3 fixes the HTTP/2 transport bundled into net/http, and golang.org/x/net v0.53.0 fixes the golang.org/x/net/http2 module (https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4918, https://go.dev/issue/78476, https://go.dev/issue/78478, https://go.dev/cl/761581, https://go.dev/cl/761640, https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/qcCIEXso47M). This package is the Go 1.26 toolchain, and its version is the Go release it packages. We inspected every published golang-1.26-dev package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository, amd64 and arm64, from 1.26.4-0 to the current 1.26.11-18; each build's go command reports the Go release in its package version. Every one of these builds packages Go 1.26.3 or later, and in the HTTP/2 transport bundled into net/http (src/net/http/h2_bundle.go) each of them carries the upstream fix: they validate every setting before applying it, as upstream Go 1.26.3 does. The code is present but fixed in every published build, so the range ends at the lowest published build, 1.26.4-0. From the http2 tree, the golang.org/x/net copy vendored under src/vendor in these packages carries only the http2/hpack subpackage, not the golang.org/x/net/http2 package the module advisory names, and src/cmd/vendor carries no golang.org/x/net code, so the matched golang.org/x/net versions add no separate exposure.
